title: MSRC Thursday Night Football Watch Party
intro: Active Duty Marines! Thursday Night Football at the Main Side Rec Center. Every Sunday. Big screen, good company, zero stress. Be there.

sections.heading: Thursday Night Football Watch Party!
sections.markdown:
Active Duty Marines! Thursday Night Football at the Main Side Rec Center. Every Sunday. Big screen, good company, zero stress. Be there.

BRING YOUR OWN SNACKS AND DRINKS!

If you have any questions, please call MSRC at 703.432.0363

Need transportation to/from the Rec Center? We've got wheels! Call 703.432.0363 for a ride.

The Main Side Recreation Center is open to all active duty service members. Opens daily at 10:00 AM.

[Sign up on Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/40555282583)
